name: ai.autoposter/autoposter
title: Auto Poster AI
description: Draft, schedule, publish and analyze social media posts on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X and more.

tools.name: autoposter_list_accounts
tools.description: Lists all connected social media accounts (LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Facebook, Telegram) in the current Autoposter workspace.

tools.name: autoposter_get_rules
tools.description: Returns platform publishing constraints including character limits, media format requirements, and guidelines.

tools.name: autoposter_upload_media
tools.description: Uploads an image or video to Auto Poster media library. Accepts a file object supplied by the client, a public image or video URL, a data URI, or base64 data. Direct chat download limit is 100MB. For larger videos or files (>100MB), tell the user to provide a direct public file URL or use autoposter_get_media_upload_url for direct S3 upload up to 5GB. If the image exists only in the chat or on the user's device and cannot be sent here, use autoposter_create_upload_link instead.

file.description: File object supplied by the client (download_url, file_id, optional mime_type and file_name) for generated or uploaded files.

url.description: Optional public image or video URL or data URI to upload into media library.

name.description: Optional display name or title for the media file.

tools.name: autoposter_get_media_upload_url
tools.description: Only for clients that can perform an HTTP PUT or multipart POST (not chat-only clients such as Gemini): if you cannot make that request yourself, use autoposter_create_upload_link instead. Generates a presigned S3 upload URL for direct, high-speed upload of videos or images up to 5GB without size limits or timeouts. Returns direct PUT url, POST upload fields, and public CDN URL.

fileName.description: Name of the file including extension (e.g. 'promo_video.mp4', 'photo.jpg').

tools.name: autoposter_create_upload_link
tools.description: Creates a short-lived link where the user can upload images from their device into the Auto Poster media library. Use this when the user wants to attach an image that exists only in the chat or on their device (no public URL) and your client cannot send file contents. Give the link to the user, wait until they say the upload is done, then call autoposter_list_media (newest first) and attach the image with mediaIds in autoposter_draft_post or autoposter_schedule_post.

tools.name: autoposter_draft_post
tools.description: Creates a draft post for human review. If API key lacks direct publish, post is saved as pending_approval and notifications are sent to workspace approvers. Accepts mediaUrls (public URLs) or files (client-supplied file objects up to 100MB). For large video files over 100MB, tell the user to provide a direct public file URL or use autoposter_get_media_upload_url.

accountIds.description: List of account IDs from autoposter_list_accounts.

content.description: Base text content of the post.

platformContent.description: Optional platform-specific content overrides (e.g. twitter, linkedin).

mediaUrls.description: Optional public image or video URLs to attach (e.g. from autoposter_upload_media).

mediaIds.description: Optional list of existing media IDs from workspace media library (from autoposter_list_media).

files.description: Optional client-supplied file objects to attach to the post.

postType.description: Optional target format where applicable: 'post' (default feed post/carousel), 'reel' (Instagram or Facebook Reel; requires video), 'story' (Instagram or Facebook 24h Story; requires image or video), or 'shorts' (YouTube Shorts; vertical video under 60s). Ignored on platforms without format variants.

firstComment.description: Optional first comment posted on the post right after it publishes (e.g. links or hashtags). Supported on platforms with comment support such as X, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord.

threadComments.description: Optional thread: follow-up texts posted in order after publishing, each replying to the previous one. If firstComment is also set, these come after it. On X this makes a tweet thread.

title.description: Optional title. Used by YouTube, Pinterest and WordPress; ignored elsewhere.

visibility.description: Optional audience for TikTok posts (default PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE). Ignored on other platforms.

tools.name: autoposter_schedule_post
tools.description: Schedules a post for a future date/time. Automatically converts local time using workspace/user timezone into UTC. Accepts mediaUrls (public URLs) or files (client-supplied file objects up to 100MB). For large video files over 100MB, tell the user to provide a direct public file URL or use autoposter_get_media_upload_url.

accountIds.description: List of account IDs from autoposter_list_accounts.

content.description: Base text content of the post.

scheduledAt.description: Scheduled ISO timestamp or local datetime string, e.g. '2026-10-05T14:00:00'.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone (e.g. 'America/New_York'). If omitted, defaults to workspace or user timezone.

platformContent.description: Optional platform-specific content overrides (e.g. twitter, linkedin).

mediaUrls.description: Optional public image or video URLs to attach (e.g. from autoposter_upload_media).

mediaIds.description: Optional list of existing media IDs from workspace media library (from autoposter_list_media).

files.description: Optional client-supplied file objects to attach to the post.

postType.description: Optional target format where applicable: 'post' (default feed post/carousel), 'reel' (Instagram or Facebook Reel; requires video), 'story' (Instagram or Facebook 24h Story; requires image or video), or 'shorts' (YouTube Shorts; vertical video under 60s). Ignored on platforms without format variants.

firstComment.description: Optional first comment posted on the post right after it publishes (e.g. links or hashtags). Supported on platforms with comment support such as X, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord.

threadComments.description: Optional thread: follow-up texts posted in order after publishing, each replying to the previous one. If firstComment is also set, these come after it. On X this makes a tweet thread.

title.description: Optional title. Used by YouTube, Pinterest and WordPress; ignored elsewhere.

visibility.description: Optional audience for TikTok posts (default PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE). Ignored on other platforms.

tools.name: autoposter_publish_draft
tools.description: Approves and immediately publishes an existing draft or pending post. Requires an API key with direct publish permission.

postId.description: The post ID returned by autoposter_draft_post.

tools.name: autoposter_get_post_status
tools.description: Checks delivery status of a post and returns live platform links/receipts once published.

tools.name: autoposter_get_post
tools.description: Retrieves a single post by ID including its state (drafts, pending_approval, queued, posted) and live link receipts.

tools.name: autoposter_delete_post
tools.description: Deletes or cancels a draft, scheduled, or pending post by ID.

postId.description: The post ID to delete or cancel.

tools.name: autoposter_update_post
tools.description: Edits an existing draft, scheduled, pending_approval or declined post in place: text, title, visibility, media, first comment / thread, or schedule time. Only the fields you pass change, and the previous values are overwritten with no undo. Posts already published or being processed cannot be edited. If the API key cannot publish directly, an edited scheduled post goes back to pending_approval.

mediaIds.description: New ordered list of media IDs from autoposter_list_media. Replaces the current media; [] removes all.

scheduledAt.description: New ISO timestamp or local datetime, e.g. '2026-10-05T14:00:00'. Must be in the future.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for scheduledAt. Defaults to the post's timezone, then UTC.

firstComment.description: Optional first comment posted on the post right after it publishes (e.g. links or hashtags). Supported on platforms with comment support such as X, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord.

threadComments.description: Optional thread: follow-up texts posted in order after publishing, each replying to the previous one. If firstComment is also set, these come after it. On X this makes a tweet thread.

title.description: Optional title. Used by YouTube, Pinterest and WordPress; ignored elsewhere.

visibility.description: Optional audience for TikTok posts (default PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE). Ignored on other platforms.

tools.name: autoposter_get_analytics
tools.description: Reads performance analytics. level 'posts' (default) returns per-post metrics (impressions, views, likes, comments, shares, clicks, ...) with totals for a date range or for one post. level 'accounts' returns the latest account-level snapshot (followers, reach, impressions, engagement, ...) per connected account, plus a daily series when from/to are given. Data is synced periodically, so very recent posts may have no metrics yet.

postId.description: level 'posts' only: return analytics for this post (from autoposter_list_posts).

accountIds.description: Limit to these accounts (IDs from autoposter_list_accounts).

platform.description: level 'posts' only: limit to one platform, e.g. 'instagram'.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default: 14 days before 'to'.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default: today (UTC). Max range 90 days.

limit.description: Max posts or series rows returned (default 20, max 50). Totals always cover all matches.

tools.name: autoposter_list_posts
tools.description: Lists posts in the workspace. Supports filtering by state ('drafts', 'scheduled', 'queued', 'posted', 'failed', 'pending_approval'), caption text search, and limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default 20, max 50).

search.description: Optional keyword to search in post captions.

tools.name: autoposter_list_media
tools.description: Lists media files (images and videos) stored in the workspace media library with public CDN URLs.

type.description: Optional filter by media type ('image' or 'video').

limit.description: Maximum number of media items to return (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials. The opaque id is unique within this app and remains unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes.
